title: Templated assembly of a μ6-CO3 2− dodecanuclear lanthanum dibenzoylmethanide hydroxido cluster with concomitant formation of phenylglyoxylate

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of 1 eq. of hydrated LaCl3 and 2 eq. of dibenzoylmethane (Ph2acacH) with an excess of triethylamine in methanol yielded a fine yellow precipitate, which was collected and washed several times with fresh methanol to remove triethylammonium chloride. The solid was dissolved in toluene and left undisturbed to evaporate slowly; yellow block-shaped crystals of [La12(OH)12(H2O)4(Ph2acac)18(Phgly)2(CO3)2] appeared after a few weeks. The reaction was reproducible under the same conditions. Repeating the reaction under nitrogen in the complete absence of CO2, including during crystallisation, and adding K2CO3 or (NH4)2CO3 failed to yield the templated dodecanuclear cluster. Carbonate in the product is attributed to atmospheric CO2 fixation during the long crystallisation.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ligand-controlled hydrolysis in methanol, then slow evaporation from toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate washed several times with methanol; dissolved in toluene and left undisturbed for slow evaporation. Yellow block-shaped crystals harvested after a few weeks.
